54.html:

the part of you that’s
scared to become her.

Hiiii my love 💜

One of the biggest things we do inside MY SZN is combine astrology, shadow work and future-self work, because knowing your birth chart is incredible, and the real magic happens when you start using what you know about yourself to change how you actually live.

You can know exactly who you want to become, have the big vision, write down the goals, decide you’re ready to make more money, become more visible, have better relationships, build the business, change your habits or completely reinvent your life, and STILL find yourself repeating the same patterns.

That’s where we start looking at the shadows underneath it all.

We don’t only ask

Who do you want to become?

We also ask

What part of you is scared to become her?

👑 Maybe you want to be more visible, and part of you learned that being seen wasn’t safe.
💸 Maybe you want more money, and you’ve got beliefs about what having money means about you.
✨ Maybe you know exactly what you need to do next, and perfectionism, procrastination or fear keeps pulling you back into the same cycle.

Inside MY SZN you’ve got journaling prompts personalised to your birth chart that help you explore your patterns, your fears, your desires, your beliefs and the parts of you that might be keeping you stuck, especially when you know what you want and cannot work out why you’re struggling to actually do it.

And we’ve got workshops that take you deeper into shadow work, where we look at everything that comes up around money, visibility, confidence, self-worth, perfectionism, becoming your future self and actually allowing yourself to have the life you’re asking for.

Your birth chart gives us the place to start exploring those patterns, the personalised journaling helps you go deeperrr, and the workshops give you practical ways to work through whatever comes up while you build the habits and the choices of the woman you actually want to become.
